title: Reset your password
text: Open the sign-in page, choose 'Forgot password' and follow the link we email you. The link works for 30 minutes.

title: Invoices and refunds
text: Invoices are sent on the 1st of each month. If you were charged twice, we refund the extra charge after a member of our team checks it.

title: Service status
text: Current outages are shown on status.northdesk.example. Enterprise customers can also call their account manager.

title: Suspended accounts
text: Accounts are suspended when an invoice is overdue for more than 14 days. Pay the invoice to unlock the account.
